spec_match.rationale: Pits the native iterator join against Array.prototype.join — the normative reference the proposal points at — across eight cases including symbols and holes.

interactive.rationale: Separator select and free-text input both re-run all cases; agreement column updates (verified via select cycling).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises reading the rules back from the platform rather than asserting them, which is the page's whole mechanism.

edge_cases.rationale: null/undefined elements, explicit-undefined vs omitted separator, ToString separators, object toString, symbol TypeError on both sides.

conformance.rationale: Suite's parity assertions mirror this page's cases; 7/7 pass natively here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: 8/8 agreement observed with the native method on this build; console clean; screenshots clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: array-parity asserts agreements === total — genuinely falsifiable and exactly the page's contract.

accessibility.rationale: Both controls labelled, detail output aria-live, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. The strongest telemetry design in the feature (falsifiable parity assert) and full native agreement observed on this 153 build.
